exposure: intending birth in a freestanding midwifery unit
intending birth in an obstetric unit
cohort: 839 low-risk women intending birth in a freestanding midwifery unit and 839 low-risk women intending birth in an obstetric unit
finding: The effect of birthplace on perinatal and maternal morbidity and the use of obstetric interventions did not differ significantly between primiparous and multiparous women in low-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: Both primiparous and multiparous women intending birth in a freestanding midwifery unit were significantly less likely to require caesarean section, instrumental delivery, augmented labour or epidural analgesia compared to their counterparts intending birth in an obstetric unit.
